info.title: Microweber CMS API
info.description:
Complete RESTful API for Microweber CMS including Content Management, E-commerce, and System Health endpoints.

## Authentication

The API uses Laravel Sanctum for authentication. Include the Bearer token in the Authorization header:
```
Authorization: Bearer <your-token>
```

## Rate Limiting

Authenticated endpoints are rate-limited to 60 requests per minute per user.

## Response Format

All endpoints return JSON responses with a consistent structure:
```json
{
  "success": true|false,
  "message": "Human-readable message",
  "data": { ... },
  "error": "Error message (if applicable)"
}
```
